summary: The PR adds genuinely new enclosure material and correctly reuses filledHull/cluster-set API, but it duplicates the existing three-theorem crosscut-criterion chain of Conformal/CutDiameter.lean instead of factoring the shared Cauchy/limit step, and it introduces the three-piece cut decomposition as a lemma while leaving the three existing inline copies of that same identity in place.
